issues.legal_issue: Whether the acquired land was subject to a legally established Blue Zone restriction on the date of the acquisition notification.
Whether the applicable building byelaws imposed a no-construction restriction within 15 metres of the defined boundary of the watercourse.
How the market value of the acquired land should be determined, including the valuation of land inside and outside the no-construction zone.

Whether comparable sale transactions and compensation awards for nearby lands could be relied on to determine market value, and whether transactions between related parties should be preferred over arm’s-length transactions.
Whether deductions for development costs, the size of the acquired tract, or the land’s location were justified in determining compensation.
Whether compensation could be awarded above the amount claimed when the claimant had not initially paid the required court fee.
Whether rental compensation was payable for the period between taking possession before the acquisition award and the making of that award, and at what rate.
